literal: Distress even if experienced, disgraceful things they will not do, wavering-free vision those people.
translation: Even if they fall into deep distress, those with unwavering vision will not commit disgraceful deeds.
modern: துன்பம் வந்தாலும், நடுக்கம் இல்லாத தெளிவான அறிவை உடையவர்கள் இழிவான செயல்களைச் செய்ய மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the steadfastness of those with clear, unwavering understanding. The word 'இடுக்கண்' (distress) sets up a scenario of extreme hardship, which often tempts people to compromise their principles. However, 'நடுக்கற்ற காட்சி' (unwavering vision or clarity) gives them the strength to resist. Consequently, they will never do 'இளிவந்த' (disgraceful or degrading) deeds, maintaining the purity of their actions regardless of their circumstances.
